entries.title: Work that merges on its own says so
entries.body: When a task merges on its own, its note now shows the same risk chart and pull request facts as a card that asks you first. It opens with a line saying it merges on its own, and once your first mate merges it, that line says when it merged, with your first mate's reason.

picture.alt: A note for a merged change with its risk chart at the top right, a line reading Merged on its own at 8:20 PM with the pull request and the first mate's sentence, and the project, model, care, pull request, lines and checks along the bottom beside Chat
